payload.summary: Product ruling (visualjc, chat 2026-08-17, transcribed by agent): calendar-anchored --since tokens (today, this-week, this-month) are wanted but kept OUT of the in-review since-relative-windows PR to hold its scope; charted as roadmap node mvxtt8yp at horizon later. 'yesterday' is excluded on the agent's recommendation and the human's acceptance: --since is a lower bound only, so it would include all of today; it needs an --until upper bound first.
